item.title: AI, Tools and Transformation
item.description:
📝 It can be very tempting to think that AI will sweep most of this away. But if you’re a really great matrimonial lawyer, you spend all your day thinking about your cases and your clients, not about what great legal discovery software would do; if you’re a really great enterprise salesperson, you spend all your time thinking about your product and your clients and your competitors, not about how great sales enablement software could make you more productive. Narrowly, that means that the task to be automated might be sitting in plain sight but the people with that task don’t see it.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ben-evans.com/benedictevans/2026/9/3/ai-tools-and-transformation
